English: Wild Olive Stand
A patch of wild olive trees, lightly tended by the nomads, offering a meager but vital supply of fruit and wood. It marks the humble beginnings of olive cultivation in the clans new land.
Clay Press Hut
A simple clay-walled hut shelters a rudimentary olive press, enabling the first production of oil for food and lamp-light. Clan members gather for the labor, fostering unity and shared purpose.
Stone Trough
A more permanent stone trough greatly improves olive processing efficiency, increasing the yield and quality of oil while supporting a growing workforce.
Timber Press Pavilion
A large timber-framed pavilion houses advanced wooden presses and workspace for many hands, allowing the clan to process olives at scale and attract more laborers and merchants.
Oil Storage Room
A secure, cool stone room stores large quantities of olive oil. This building preserves the clans surplus, improves logistical supply, and facilitates trade with passing caravans.
Expanded Orchard
A vast orchard of cultivated olive trees, maintained by a sizable workforce. The settlement becomes renowned for its oil, attracting migrants and boosting prosperity.
Merchants Olivehouse
A grand olivehouse where merchants convene to buy, trade, and store premium oil. The clan profits from trade routes and attracts skilled laborers and traders.
Walled Grove
A fortified olive grove protected by stone walls, employing guards and laborers. The security enables uninterrupted growth, attracts further settlers, and projects the clans prestige.
Oil Market Pavilion
A bustling market complex where olive oil is sold throughout the region, attracting distant traders and enriching the nomadic clans coffers.
Israelite Olive Estate
A legendary estate renowned throughout the Near East, uniting orchards, presses, markets, and secure storage, and serving as a symbol of the clans unity and prosperity.
